Built and running
2026 · Computer vision

EnergyCam

CCTV that catches ACs running in empty rooms. It counts people with YOLOv8, checks each AC, and emails the facilities team a snapshot after 10 seconds of waste.

  • Runs on existing IP cameras over RTSP
  • Two ACs per room, readings smoothed over four frames
  • Alert and "resolved" emails with a snapshot
  • Live dashboard with waste cost in rupees
